answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Each submission hangs on the sonnet of a task receipt, and the marble is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the relic of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, weighted by independent path length, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
